description: This file implements a versioning codec for Kubernetes API objects, including functions for creating codecs, encoding, decoding, and managing object versions and serialization details.

classes.name: codec
classes.description: A struct implementing runtime.Codec for encoding and decoding Kubernetes objects with versioning support.

methods.name: NewDefaultingCodecForScheme
methods.description: Creates a new Codec with default settings for a given scheme.

methods.name: NewCodec
methods.description: Constructs a new Codec instance with specified encoder, decoder, convertor, and versioning info.

methods.name: identifier
methods.description: Computes a unique identifier for the codec based on its parameters.

methods.name: Decode
methods.description: Decodes data into a runtime object, converting to internal version if needed.

methods.name: EncodeWithAllocator
methods.description: Encodes an object with a specified memory allocator.

methods.name: Encode
methods.description: Encodes an object without a custom memory allocator.

methods.name: doEncode
methods.description: Performs the actual encoding process, handling special object types and conversions.

methods.name: doEncode
methods.description: Performs encoding with optional memory allocation support.

methods.name: Identifier
methods.description: Returns the identifier of the codec.
